criteria.personal-story: Persuades through the speaker's own story or a narrative example of someone's donation experience or of a beneficiary's outcome.
criteria.foot-in-the-door: Asks for or normalises a small donation (e.g. even a tiny amount helps) as a first, easy step towards agreeing to give.
criteria.self-modeling: Says the speaker will donate too (or match the donation), acting as a role model for the listener to follow.
criteria.none: No persuasion strategy: a greeting, thanks, acknowledgement, closing, praise or off-task remark with no persuasive appeal.
